blocks.text: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump is expected to name Jay Clayton, the US director of national intelligence, as the White House’s new AI czar, CNN and other US media reported Friday. CBS News reported a day earlier that Clayton was the likely pick and that the administration had discussed keeping him in his intelligence post, with Trump expected to make a final decision shortly. A White House official told CBS that any personnel announcement would come directly from the president, dismissing the reports as speculation.
